core_obligations: Show that a relative r-cycle alpha on X/S is proper if and only if every base change g_i^*alpha along an h covering {g_i : S_i to S} is (proof lines 2136-2155). Forward direction: lemma-proper-functoriality (tag 0H62) (proof lines 2137-2138). Converse: since properness is checked affine locally on S, assume S affine; refine the covering by a single proper surjective morphism g : T to S with T the union of an open covering by the T_j, so beta = g^*alpha is proper over T (properness being checked on an open cover) (proof lines 2139-2144); by lemma-support-family (tag 0H4V) the support of beta is the inverse image of the support of alpha under f : Y = T times_S X to X, so the closure W of f^{-1}Supp(alpha) in Y is proper over T (proof lines 2144-2148); since T to S is proper, W is proper over S by transitivity of properness (proof lines 2148-2149); by coherent-lemma-functoriality-closed-proper-over-base (tag 0CYQ) the image f(W) is a closed subset of X proper over S, and it contains Supp(alpha), so the closure of the support of alpha is a closed subset of a set proper over S, whence alpha is proper (proof lines 2150-2154).
proof_roadmap: Forward direction by functoriality of properness (proof lines 2137-2138).
Work affine locally and refine the h covering to one proper surjective morphism with an open cover carrying the pulled back properness (proof lines 2139-2144).

Transfer properness to the closure of the inverse image of the support via the support lemma, propagate along the proper covering, and conclude from the closed proper image containing the support (proof lines 2144-2154).
